GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. The dhi-kserve APK ships manager, agent, router, localmodel, and localmodelnode binaries built from kserve v0.20; none of these binaries import or link golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, so the vulnerable OpenPGP code is not present in the shipped artifacts (vulnerable_code_not_present).

Loki 2.9.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. v0.311.3 drops github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which Loki 2.9.x still imports from pkg/ingester. Reachability of the legacy heatmap render path on the Loki 2.9 binary has not been verified to match the 3.7 not_affected analysis. Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping this track.

CVE-2026-44903 (GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28) is a stored XSS in the Prometheus server's legacy web UI heatmap, which is only rendered when the prometheus binary is launched with --enable-feature=old-ui. Loki 2.9.x imports github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web/api/v1 only for the PrometheusVersion struct (version reporting in pkg/loki/version_handler.go and pkg/util/build/build.go); the legacy web UI templates and heatmap render path are not imported or compiled into the Loki binary. Loki 2.9.x cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which pkg/ingester still imports.

CVE-2026-42154 affects the Prometheus server's remote-read HTTP handler (/api/v1/read), which uses a snappy decoder that does not validate declared payload length before allocating memory. Loki 3.7.x uses github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote only on the client side (pkg/ruler/storage/instance/instance.go calls remote.NewStorage for the ruler WAL) and never instantiates remote.NewReadHandler or routes /api/v1/read in its HTTP server, so the vulnerable handler is not reachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-42154 affects the Prometheus server's remote-read HTTP handler (/api/v1/read), which uses a snappy decoder that does not validate declared payload length before allocating memory. Loki 2.9.x uses github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote only on the client side (pkg/ruler/storage/instance/instance.go calls remote.NewStorage for the ruler WAL) and never instantiates remote.NewReadHandler or routes /api/v1/read in its HTTP server, so the vulnerable handler is not reachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7.x has the same client-only remote storage posture. Loki 2.9.x cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which pkg/ingester still imports. Loki 3.7.x cannot take the v0.311.3 bump because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-42151 affects the Prometheus server's /api/v1/status/config endpoint failing to redact the Azure AD remote-write OAuth client_secret field. Loki 3.7.x vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote/azuread transitively via config and storage/remote/client, but does not expose /api/v1/status/config or any equivalent endpoint that serializes its remote-write configuration back over HTTP, so the vulnerable config-display path is unreachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE in Prometheus because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.
